CORE MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 16
   C. 32
   D. 22

3. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 32
   C. 64
   D. 9

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

5. Solve for x: x + 7 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 18
   D. 11

6. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 9

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

9. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

10. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 23
   C. 19
   D. 7

12. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

13. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 2
   D. 48

14. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

15. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

16. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

17. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

18. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 1

19. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 40
   C. 75
   D. 20

20. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 37
   C. 5
   D. 13

21. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 36

22. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

23. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

24. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 7

25. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x < 5
   D. x = 5

26. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

27. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

28. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

29. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

30. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36
